cd /testbed && patch -p1 <<'PATCH'
--- a/tests/unit/acl.tcl
+++ b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
@@ -1171,6 +1171,36 @@
 }
 
 
+set aclfile [file normalize [file join [tmpdir "replica.acl"] "users.acl"]]
+exec cp -f tests/assets/nodefaultuser.acl $aclfile
+start_server [list overrides [list aclfile $aclfile repl-diskless-sync-delay 0] tags {acl repl network external:skip}] {
+    start_server [list overrides [list aclfile $aclfile]] {
+        test {ACL LOAD on a replica preserves the primary connection} {
+            set primary [srv -1 client]
+            set replica [srv 0 client]
+            $replica replicaof [srv -1 host] [srv -1 port]
+            wait_for_sync $replica
+
+            $replica ACL SETUSER alice -get
+            $replica AUTH alice ""
+            assert_error {*NOPERM*} {$replica GET acl-reload-key}
+
+            assert_equal OK [$replica ACL LOAD]
+            assert_equal alice [$replica ACL WHOAMI]
+            assert_equal +@all [dict get [$replica ACL GETUSER alice] commands]
+
+            $replica AUTH default ""
+            $replica ACL SETUSER default -set
+            # The primary connection must remain unrestricted by the default user's ACL.
+            $primary SET acl-reload-key value
+            wait_for_ofs_sync $primary $replica
+            assert_equal value [$replica GET acl-reload-key]
+            assert_equal up [status $replica master_link_status]
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+
 start_server {overrides {user "default on nopass ~* +@all"} tags {"external:skip"}} {
